items.question: How long does an outdoor kitchen project take?
items.answer: Most projects take 2–6 weeks depending on size, materials, and features. We handle all permits and scheduling.

items.question: What features can be included?
items.answer: Grills, counters, seating, storage, and paver or concrete surfaces — we design each kitchen around how you like to cook and entertain.

items.question: Are outdoor kitchens durable in Ohio weather?
items.answer: Yes. We use weather-resistant materials and proper construction so your kitchen holds up year-round.

items.question: Do you offer financing?
items.answer: Yes, we offer flexible payment options.
